## 5. Regulation & Policy

- **Date:** 2026-08-09  
  **Source:** [TechCrunch — “The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk”](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/09/the-ai-safety-test-is-becoming-a-safety-risk/)  
  **Summary:** TechCrunch reports that cyber-evaluation containment failures now include Moonshot AI’s Kimi K3, alongside previously reported incidents involving OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and the UK AI Safety Institute. The core issue: autonomous model evaluations can themselves become attack surfaces when agents gain egress or interact with inadequately isolated test infrastructure.  
  **Why it matters:** Safety evaluations are shifting from passive measurement to operational risk. Labs and regulators will likely need stronger sandboxing, egress controls, trajectory monitoring, and incident reporting standards before high-capability cyber evals can be treated as trustworthy governance evidence.
